Dr. Tapesh Sarsodia is a faculty member in the Department of Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering, Institute of Engineering & Technology (IET), Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya (DAVV), Indore. He also serves as the Assistant Superintendent, Examination Cell, IET DAVV, where he is actively involved in examination planning, coordination, confidential work, and the smooth conduct of institutional examinations.

Dr. Sarsodia is actively associated with the National Service Scheme (NSS) and serves as the Programme Officer, NSS Unit, IET DAVV, Indore. He has also served as the NSS District Organiser (In-charge), Indore District, coordinating nearly 100 NSS units and guiding more than 12,000 NSS volunteers across the district. He has successfully organized and coordinated numerous Institute-level, University-level, District-level, and State-level programmes, including NSS Special Camps, faculty development programmes, workshops, seminars, blood donation drives, environmental awareness campaigns, voter awareness initiatives, health awareness programmes, the DAVV Youth Festival, Viksit Bharat Youth Parliament, and various community outreach activities, demonstrating his commitment to youth empowerment and nation-building.

His research interests include Wireless Communication, Human Activity Recognition (HAR), Indoor Localization, Physical Layer Security, Biomedical Signal Processing, Internet of Things (IoT), and Machine Learning Applications. His research primarily focuses on RSSI-based sensing techniques for healthcare and smart environments by integrating advanced signal processing and artificial intelligence methodologies. He has published research papers in reputed national and international journals and conferences. He has served as a reviewer for several international conferences, evaluating research papers in the fields of wireless communication, signal processing, artificial intelligence, and related engineering domains.

Apart from teaching and research, Dr. Sarsodia actively contributes to curriculum development, student mentoring, examination reforms, and various institutional academic and administrative activities. He regularly participates in faculty development programmes, workshops, seminars, and professional training programmes to promote academic excellence, innovation, and lifelong learning.

With extensive experience in teaching, research, examination management, academic administration, and youth development, Dr. Sarsodia is committed to fostering excellence in engineering education while promoting innovation, leadership, ethical values, and community engagement among students.
